source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of transcription and the two DNA strands (PDF 133).

blocks.text: Transcription gene expression ka pehla qadam hai. Transcription mein DNA se complementary (jor wala) RNA banta hai. DNA ka sirf aik strand transcribe hota hai jise template strand kehte hain, aur banne wala mRNA isi template strand ka complementary hota hai. DNA ka doosra strand, jo transcribe nahin hota, coding strand kehlata hai, kyun ke us ka sequence mRNA jaisa hi hota hai, bas mRNA mein jahan U hai wahan coding strand mein T hota hai. mRNA ki transcription ke bare marahil (phases) aage diye gaye hain.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: DNA ke template strand ko antisense (–) strand aur coding strand ko sense (+) strand bhi kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Coding strand ATG GCT hai. Template strand aur mRNA kya honge?
blocks.explanation: Template strand (3′ se 5′): TAC CGA. mRNA: AUG GCU, yaani coding strand jaisa, bas T ki jagah U.

items: Sirf template (antisense) strand transcribe hota hai.
Coding (sense) strand ka sequence mRNA jaisa, bas U ki jagah T.
